description: Free. Decode one x402 v2 payment request (base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, PaymentRequired JSON or MCP tool result) and list every accepts option with exact atomic and decimal amounts. Token addresses are compared with a limited reference list. status: parsed, ambiguous (options differ in recipient, network or amount; none is chosen), malformed or unsupported. Does not verify the merchant, authorize a transfer, assess fraud risk, or guarantee any payment. URLs in the input are never fetched.

raw.description: The payment request. A string: the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (a leading 'PAYMENT-REQUIRED:' is allowed) or JSON text. An object: the PaymentRequired JSON, or for transport mcp the tool result (structuredContent, _meta x402/error or content[0].text).

transport.description: Where the request came from: http (402 response) or mcp (paid tool result). Default http.

name: x402_parse_payment_request

parsed.description: The decoded request with every accepts option (null unless status is parsed or ambiguous).

provenance.description: Version and sources of the bundled asset table.

status.description: parsed = the checked x402 v2 structure had no defects (not a statement about the merchant or whether to pay). ambiguous = options differ in recipient, network or amount; none was chosen. malformed / unsupported = could not be fully read.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Parse an x402 payment request
